stem: According to the demographics provided, approximately what percentage of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians live in very remote settings?
explanation: While media representation often focuses on remote areas, only a small minority of the population actually resides in very remote settings.
rationale: Consider the distinction between total remote settings and specifically 'very remote' settings mentioned in the transcript.

optionExplanations.A: While media representation often focuses on remote areas, only a small minority of the population actually resides in very remote settings.
optionExplanations.B: This figure represents the total percentage of the population living in any remote setting, not just those in very remote areas.
optionExplanations.C: This would imply a much higher remote distribution than reality, as the majority of the population lives in non-remote areas.
optionExplanations.D: This figure is closer to the proportion of the population that lives in major metropolitan or regional centers rather than remote ones.
